transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Hello! I'm Dora, and I've just completed your post-cataract surgery follow-up check. 

Do you have any questions about your surgery or your recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First off, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Great question! You can start doing light gardening after 1 week following your surgery. However, you should avoid any strenuous or heavy exercise for a full month. So gentle gardening is fine, but nothing too demanding.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Good question. If you were using eye gel for dry eyes before your operation, it's safe to continue using it now, unless you've been told otherwise by your doctor.

If you don't have any left, your GP should be able to provide more for you.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I have another question. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
Some sensitivity to bright light is quite normal as your eyes adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside.

However, if you're experiencing significant pain in bright light, or if your eye is also red and painful, that's not normal and we may need to assess it further. In that case, it's best to contact your care team.

Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: Some sensitivity to bright light is quite normal as your eyes adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It's common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after surgery, and it should improve quickly and settle down over time.

How long has it been since your operation? If your vision is still quite blurry or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything is okay.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I don't have any more questions. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Brilliant! So just to confirm - have all your questions been answered today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome! Take care, and don't hesitate to contact your care team if you have any concerns.

verdict.label: fail
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` and `mild_case_advice` in the turn starting "Some sensitivity to bright light is quite normal...". However, the `escalation_criteria` point was not conveyed at all. The agent was interrupted before it could deliver this information.
